"""Adversarial sizing: many assignments, all distinct costs, non-binding quotas."""
import random, sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import ipaddress
from common import validate
from planning import solve

def build(nreq, noff, per, seed=3, cap=4096, quota_cap=4096, nquota=64):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    leases = [{'id': 'L0', 'prefix': '2001:db8::/56', 'start': 0, 'end': 10**12 + 1,
               'subnets': list(range(16)), 'low_count': 32}]
    services = [{'id': 'tcp0', 'kind': 'tcp'}]
    rq = [{'id': 'q0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': quota_cap}]
    for i in range(1, nquota):
        rq.append({'id': 'q%d' % i, 'parent': 'q%d' % rnd.randrange(i), 'capacity': quota_cap})
    oq = [{'id': 'p0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': quota_cap}]
    for i in range(1, nquota):
        oq.append({'id': 'p%d' % i, 'parent': 'p%d' % rnd.randrange(i), 'capacity': quota_cap})
    requests = []
    for i in range(nreq):
        subnet = i % 16
        iid = 1 + (i // 16) % 32
        addr = (0x2001 << 112) | (0xdb8 << 96) | (subnet << 64) | iid
        requests.append({'id': 'r%05d' % i, 'at': 10, 'lease': 'L0',
                         'target': str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(addr)), 'service': 'tcp0',
                         'group': 'q%d' % rnd.randrange(nquota)})
    offers = []
    costs = rnd.sample(range(10**9 + 1), noff)
    for i in range(noff):
        listed = ['r%05d' % k for k in rnd.sample(range(nreq), min(per, nreq))]
        offers.append({'id': 'o%05d' % i, 'time': 10 + i, 'service': 'tcp0',
                       'prefix': '2001:db8::/32', 'capacity': cap, 'cost': costs[i],
                       'group': 'p%d' % rnd.randrange(nquota), 'requests': listed})
    return {'version': 3, 'seed': 'sd', 'leases': leases, 'services': services, 'queries': [10],
            'captures': [], 'requests': requests, 'offers': offers,
            'request_quotas': rq, 'offer_quotas': oq}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    for nreq, noff, per in ((500, 500, 50), (1000, 1000, 50), (2000, 4000, 64), (4096, 8192, 64)):
        job = build(nreq, noff, per)
        ctx = validate(job)
        active = {r['id']: True for r in job['requests']}
        t = time.time(); plan = solve(ctx, active); dt = time.time() - t
        print('nreq=%d noff=%d per=%d resolved=%d %.1fs maxrss=%.0fMB' % (
            nreq, noff, per, plan['resolved'], dt, resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
